BOUNDARY: Fully supported at defined fixture datum; no external preload
CRITERION: Repeatability must be within calibrated measurement uncertainty; otherwise investigate setup/configuration
INTERFACE_PART: Complete P0 excluding removable sensor cables if separately weighed
PROCEDURE: Condition; tare; weigh; repeat; document configuration and balance state

BOUNDARY: Known datum support points; no free translation
CRITERION: Residual/reconciliation must fall within the fixture measurement uncertainty budget
LOAD: Static reaction balance / multi-point weighing fixture
OBJECTIVE: Determine CG in defined P0 coordinate system
OUTPUT: CG vector in P0 frame + uncertainty
PROCEDURE: Acquire support reactions at defined orientations; solve CG from measured reactions and surveyed geometry

BOUNDARY: Rigidly mounted to fixture; axis survey traceable to P0 frame
CRITERION: Repeatability within instrument uncertainty; cross-check tensor symmetry/positive-definiteness
INSTRUMENTATION: Angular displacement/velocity sensors + fixture reaction measurements
LOAD: Controlled pendulum/rotation test fixture or certified inertia measurement system
PROCEDURE: Measure known rotational response about principal or orthogonal axes; solve tensor; document fixture contribution subtraction
SAMPLING: >=1 kS/s for dynamic rotation fixture; higher if system requires

BOUNDARY: Specified material lot and heat treatment
CRITERION: Lot result traceable to certificate and measurement uncertainty
OBJECTIVE: Determine density/material mass model inputs where CAD mass cannot be trusted from material definition
PROCEDURE: Identify material lot; measure density; retain MTR/CoA
TRACE: R4.1 -> material regions used in CAD mass model

BOUNDARY: Surface finish, lubrication, temperature and velocity recorded
CRITERION: Stable repeatable identification with documented uncertainty; configuration-specific results retained
INSTRUMENTATION: Normal and tangential force transducers + displacement/velocity
INTERFACE_PART: S1/S2 guide/runner and any friction-controlled lock/contact interfaces
OBJECTIVE: Measure friction at each structurally relevant sliding interface
OUTPUT: mu_s/mu_k vs normal load/velocity/temp where applicable
PROCEDURE: Condition surfaces; apply defined normal load; run multiple velocity directions/cycles; identify static and kinetic coefficients
REPEAT_COUNT: >=5 cycles per configuration unless fixture repeatability dictates more
SAMPLING: >=2 kS/s static/quasi-static; >=20 kS/s dynamic if rate effects investigated

BOUNDARY: Actual surface materials and contact geometry
CRITERION: Model fit residuals and repeatability reported; no generic stiffness substitution
INTERFACE_PART: Rail/stop/guide contacts and mechanical stops used in P0
PROCEDURE: Acquire loading/unloading curves; fit local tangent/contact law in the operating displacement region
SAMPLING: >=20 kS/s for dynamic contact; slower for quasi-static characterization

CRITERION: Unique fit without unstable extrapolation; report range of validity
LOAD: Controlled repeated impacts at known approach velocity
PROCEDURE: Measure loading/unloading energy and velocity dependence; identify damping law

BOUNDARY: Known impact velocity, normal load and surface state
CRITERION: Repeatable coefficient/relationship; reject runs with fixture motion or secondary contacts
PROCEDURE: Compute rebound/approach velocity ratio; repeat over defined velocity range

BOUNDARY: Correct mounting clevises and loading axis
CRITERION: Curve must be traceable to exact cartridge serial and configuration; no curve averaging across different cartridges without provenance
LOAD: Quasi-static and controlled dynamic extension/compression over available stroke
PROCEDURE: Cycle through full allowable travel; identify regions, hysteresis and end effects

BOUNDARY: Same temperature/configuration recorded for each run
CRITERION: Rate dependency identified without extrapolation outside measured domain
LOAD: Multiple commanded stroke rates spanning the intended operating regime
PROCEDURE: Run rate sweep; derive velocity from calibrated displacement channel; fit only within tested domain

BOUNDARY: Thermal soak verified; cartridge serial tracked
CRITERION: Temperature effect quantified; no substitution of untested temperature behavior
LOAD: Same mechanical profile at multiple controlled temperatures covering validated lab range; source concept notes -40 to +80 C operating range
PROCEDURE: Thermally condition; verify soak; run identical profile; compare force/work/hysteresis

CRITERION: Drift quantified; any structural/leakage degradation recorded
LOAD: Repeated controlled cycles within validated stroke/rate envelope
PROCEDURE: Cycle; inspect; re-characterize after defined blocks; retain all serials
REPEAT_COUNT: Per supplier/test-lab capability; sufficient to expose drift, with count defined before test execution

BOUNDARY: Exact fastener class, grip length, washers, nut and torque/preload method recorded
CRITERION: Configuration-specific stiffness law with preload state retained
INTERFACE_PART: Hinges, rail mounts, absorber clevis and lock mounts
LOAD: Controlled axial/shear preload and joint excitation
OBJECTIVE: Identify bolt/joint stiffness and preload sensitivity
PROCEDURE: Measure load-displacement at multiple preload states; isolate joint compliance from fixture compliance
SAMPLING: >=1 kS/s quasi-static; higher for dynamic compliance

CRITERION: Compliance law resolved sufficiently to reproduce measured hysteresis/clearance
PROCEDURE: Sweep both directions through operating range; separate friction, clearance and elastic compliance

BOUNDARY: Restraint path mechanically independent and secured
CRITERION: No unintended release in defined non-trigger cases; intended transition reproducible; source timing targets treated as design requirements to be verified, not assumed results
LOAD: Controlled acceleration/force event plus manual fault cases
OBJECTIVE: Measure lock/trigger state transition and unintended-release behavior
OUTPUT: State transition truth table and measured latency
PROCEDURE: Exercise S0->S1->S2->S4/S5 as applicable; test no-trigger, trigger and disturbance cases; record release latency

BOUNDARY: Hard travel limits installed; absorber/lock configuration documented
CRITERION: Smooth travel, no binding, both rails engaged, stop/rebound functions remain available
LOAD: External controlled actuator/fixture or equivalent bench load
OBJECTIVE: Prove basic guided translation and stop behavior without occupant
PROCEDURE: Dry-run; low-load; incremental load to verified safe envelope; record travel and rail load sharing

BOUNDARY: Ride-down path independently restrained in fixture when isolating rotation path
CRITERION: Rotation-control path produces distinct measurable reaction independent of absorber force-stroke law
PROCEDURE: Apply controlled rotation while preventing longitudinal carriage translation, then repeat with carriage free

BOUNDARY: Primary stroke completed within test fixture; stop conditions enforced
CRITERION: Reverse motion is measurably controlled and state transition is recorded; no uncontrolled return or interference
LOAD: Controlled reverse carriage motion after primary stroke
PROCEDURE: Drive carriage through primary stroke; release/reverse under controlled conditions; measure reverse velocity and secondary excursion

BOUNDARY: No human occupants; ATD only after subsystem gates
CRITERION: Evidence of state sequence, load paths, translation, rotation control and rebound without uncontrolled failure
INPUT: Vehicle pulse / initial velocity only when externally sourced and approved; otherwise use laboratory-shaped input documented as a test command, not a vehicle pulse
OBJECTIVE: Integrated controlled dynamic screening for coupled translation + rotation + rebound
OUTPUT: Integrated physical evidence set for Manus
PROCEDURE: Execute only after component characterization and proof load checks; synchronize input and response; post-test inspection
RAW_DATA: Full synchronized DAQ package + video + configuration manifest
REPEAT_COUNT: >=3 screening events or until evidence sufficiency is demonstrated
SAMPLING: >=20 kS/s dynamic channels; video >=1000 fps starting point
TRACE: R4.1 -> prototype architecture -> future MBD/FE correlation
